From e46b5a6470a5e2c8e1096f8f60887ac19949055b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2015 22:06:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
index 86217db2937a..992736b5229b 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX25) += \
 	imx25-eukrea-mbimxsd25-baseboard-dvi-vga.dtb \
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
 	imx27-eukrea-mbimxsd27-baseboard.dtb \
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile`**
   - The line that previously added device tree blobs (dtbs) for the i.MX31 SoC has been modified. 
   - The line `dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \` has been changed to `dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \`, indicating that the build rule for the i.MX27 dtb is now correctly associated with the `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27` configuration option instead of `CONFIG_SOC_IMX31`.

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Makefile` corrects the build rule for the i.MX27 device tree blobs, ensuring that they are built when the `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27` option is enabled. This change addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (cb612390e546) that incorrectly linked the i.MX27 dtb build to the i.MX31 configuration, thereby fixing the build process for the i.MX27 SoC.

Here is the commit message:
ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect association of the i.MX27 device tree blob (dtb) build rule with the `CONFIG_SOC_IMX31` configuration option instead of the correct `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27`. This misconfiguration led to the i.MX27 dtb not being built when it should have been, resulting in potential build failures or runtime issues for systems using the i.MX27 SoC.

Here is the patch:
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \

Reason:
The i.MX27 device tree blob (dtb) was incorrectly associated with the `CONFIG_SOC_IMX31` configuration option, which meant that the dtb files for i.MX27 would not be built when the correct configuration for i.MX27 was enabled, leading to build failures or runtime issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \

```
Reason:
The patch corrects the association by changing the build rule to use `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27`, ensuring that the i.MX27 dtb files are built when the appropriate configuration is enabled, thus resolving the build issue.
